- memory_id "1000690": The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: Ledger, reporting service, billing runs)

- memory_id "1000644": Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember)
- memory_id "1000591" [decision]: Clients will cache feature-flag evaluations from the flags service for 30 seconds as of 2025-08-20.  (about: flags service)
- memory_id "1000561": After the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.  (about: billing-api, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000482" [constraint]: Changes to billing-api need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing-api)
- memory_id "1000422": The reports pipeline is not a Boreal service.  (about: Boreal, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000418": The reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: Ledger is pinned to Postgres 14 as of 2025-05-30.  (about: Ledger, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000340": The webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: webhooks service, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000333" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000326": Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000245" [constraint]: billing-api can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.  (about: billing-api)
- memory_id "1000237": Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: Ledger, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000167" [decision]: The flags service moved from Team Atlas to the Cinder team as of 2025-02-13.  (about: Team Atlas, Cinder, flags service)
- memory_id "1000163": Priya walked Diego through the flags service runbook on 2025-02-13 as part of the handover.  (about: Priya, Diego, flags service)
- memory_id "1000144" [constraint]: Team Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday as of 2025-01-31.  (about: Team Atlas)
- memory_id "1000037": Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api)
- memory_id "1000031": Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08.  (about: Team Atlas, Ledger)
Existing entity names: Ledger, reporting service, billing runs, event bus, Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember, flags service, billing-api, marketing send, Boreal, reports pipeline, retention change, Postgres 14, client rollout, INC-2025-011, authentication gateway, Cinder, Priya, Diego
